dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product scrolls a list, a column of cards or a form inside a box of a fixed size and needs every such box to say, at its edges, that more lies beyond them, in the product's one manner, without restyling or replacing the platform's own scrolling.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a scroll area reads: which scroll edge it draws, the shadow band's color and depth, the fade band's depth, the line's color and width, the blur band's depth, radius and layers, and the fade of an edge in and out. The area has no fill, edge or corner of its own.
rules: shadow.color is the color of the surface the area stands on, and defaults to sys.color.surface. A product that places the area on another surface (a card, a sheet, a container color) sets this token for it, in a layer or on the one instance, so that the band is the surface's own color.
Over a transparent surface, a picture or a video, choose fade: it fades the content itself and draws no color.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw an edge of your own over the area.

scroll-edge.$description: What marks an edge of the area while content lies beyond it: shadow, fade, line or blur. Follows the system's choice; the scrollEdge prop overrides it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product marks the edges of its bars and dialogs one way and wants its scrolling lists marked another — a blurred top bar over lists that sink into their surface — and sets the scroll area apart in its layer rather than on every instance.

color.$description: The color of the shadow band: the color of the surface the area stands on, full at the edge and none at the band's inner end. Defaults to the plain surface; set it to the surface the area stands on.

extent.$description: How deep the shadow band reaches in from its edge.
How deep the content fades, from none of it shown at the edge to all of it at this depth.

color.$description: The line along an edge while content lies beyond it: a decorative boundary, as a divider is.

extent.$description: How deep the blur band reaches in from its edge.

radius.$description: The blur's radius at the edge, falling to none at the band's inner end.

layers.$description: In how many layers of evenly stepped radius the blur band is drawn.

duration.$description: How long an edge's mark takes to fade in when content starts lying beyond the edge, and out when it stops.
